svg.title: Glacier container architecture
svg.desc: Docker Compose topology for Glacier on one user-defined bridge network, glacier-net. The host publishes three ports: 8080 to nginx port 80, 3001 to Grafana port 3000, and 8082 to Adminer port 8080 (Adminer runs only with the tools profile). Request path: 1) browser to nginx through localhost:8080, 2) nginx proxies /api and /gateway round-robin to backend:3000 on three replicas, 3) the backend writes to mariadb-primary and runs SQL reads on mariadb-replica, which follows the primary through binlog replication. The backend also uses redis for cache and pub/sub and minio for file uploads, and nginx serves /files from minio. Prometheus scrapes the backend, minio and the exporters (mysqld-exporter for both databases, redis-exporter, nginx-exporter, node-exporter, cadvisor); Grafana queries Prometheus. Named volumes: glacier_redis, glacier_mariadb-primary, glacier_mariadb-replica, glacier_minio, glacier_prometheus and glacier_grafana.
svg.text: Published to localhost: 8080 nginx, 3001 Grafana, 8082 Adminer (tools profile)
